messages:
sam: quick heads up  i'm opening a tiny PR to add a short "GFLOP-normalized" example to model cards so readers can roughly compare throughput across GPUs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1610 :wave:

ivy: Nice. Keep it short and explicit: show the formula, a one-line worked example, and the perf-harness command we ran.

sam: Plan: add a 1-paragraph explanation + formula: norm_tps = measured_tps * (device_gflops / baseline_gflops). Mark it as heuristic.

pete: Call out that this is only for rough alignment, not billing or exact latency conversion. Also add a short sentence about hosted endpoint noise (approx 5-12%).

sam: Example I'll include:
```
# perf-harness example (copyable)
python perf_harness.py --model polaris13b --seq_len 1024 --batch 1 --iters 400 --device a100 --quant fp16 --collect p50,p95,tokens_per_s
# sample output: p50=15ms p95=28ms tokens_per_s=1400
# GFLOP-normalized example: normalized_to_a100 = 1400 * (125 / 312) = 560 (heuristic)
```

ivy: Good. Also include a 1-line checklist at top of model-card template: "Include device, seq_len, batch, warmup_iters" so authors don't forget.

pete: Reviewer plan: eng-ml sanity-check the worked example numbers and the GFLOP values, docs for copyedit. If canonical numbers change, add a perf follow-up issue.

perf-bot: On PR open I will post the standard docs checklist and add labels. (automated)

sam: i'll tag reviewers in the PR description and replace any stale perf links with https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-harness#readme. merging plan: prefer eng-ml signoff, otherwise merge and file perf follow-up. last_message_ts=3612345890
